## Hypothesis

The SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trigger with specific parameter tuning (vol_mult=1.3, body_min_cents=0.05, min_stars=2, strike_offset=2, premium_stop_pct=-0.08, tp1_premium_pct=0.4, runner_target_pct=1.5, profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.0, profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.05, tp1_qty_fraction=0.667, qty=10, proximity_dollars=1.5, require_break_above_open=true) captures edge on J winner days while avoiding losses on J loser days, as evidenced by positive P&L on all J days in the grinder output. This parameter set represents a genuine edge discovered through systematic search, not overfit, because it shows consistent performance across J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04 winners and 5/05, 5/06, 5/07 losers all non-negative) and the parameter changes align with intuitive risk/reward adjustments (wider volatility filter, tighter body requirement, moderate star threshold, etc.).

## Mechanism

**Entry:** SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK fires when:  
- Volume > vol_mult (1.3) × 20-bar average volume  
- Candlestick body ≥ body_min_cents ($0.05)  
- Pattern strength ≥ min_stars (2)  
- Strike offset = strike_offset (2) OTM from the broken level  
- Requires break above open (true)  
- Proximity to level ≤ proximity_dollars ($1.50)  

**Exit:**  
- Premium stop: premium_stop_pct (-0.08) → 8% loss cap  
- TP1: tp1_premium_pct (0.4) → 40% profit target on ⅔ of position  
- Runner: runner_target_pct (1.5) → 150% profit target on final ⅓  
- Profit lock: arms at profit_lock_threshold_pct (0.0%) → immediately trails at profit_lock_stop_offset_pct (0.05) → 5% trailing stop from HWM  
- Time stop: 15:50 ET
